name: simulate-aggregate-roth-conversion-target-boundary
why: Measured reach for the annual aggregate Roth-conversion target coordinator extracted from simulatePlan. The full corpus exercises inactive and missing-contract ACA envelopes, named-action suppression, none/manual/optimized/fill-to-target selection, annual-window exclusion, sizing, taxable-to-gross translation, result reuse, and the caller's primary/downstream signal consumption in all four equivalence modes. Direct contract tests own synthetic known-ACA branches, zero-taxable sources, target failures, safety-net trimming, and lazy-read timing. Hostile delegation tests prove the caller consumes the coordinator's desired amount, warnings, ACA sizing envelope, fill-to-target signal, and then-current taxable translator without rebuilding those decisions inline.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. Direct coordinator tests own synthetic known-ACA, zero-taxable-source, target-failure, lazy-read, warning, and safety-trim branches; hostile delegation owns exact output consumption and callback timing. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary or compound operand sharing a physical line, so reported cold sub-line regions must be read alongside those focused tests.
